name: Independent Amount 1
definition: Indicates the independent amount and how it was applied in the calculation.

Convention.name: Convention
Convention.definition: Determines how the independent amount was applied in the calculation. |It is either:|- before threshold, effectively acting as an add on to exposure, |- after threshold where the amount is an add on to the credit support amount and forms part of the variation margin requirement,|- segregated where it is treated independently of variation margin for segregation purposes.
